name: AuditWhy
tagline: Autonomous multi-agent financial, taxonomic, and operational discrepancy investigator that explains WHY enterprise metrics diverge, catches cross-system data quality orphans, blocks unverified hypotheses, and compounds institutional memory.

tracks.primary: Track 02 — The Agent That Can Explain Why

components: Zetaris Networked Data Platform REST SQL Client (Port 8888 /api/v1.0)
Unified Semantic Layer (USL) COMPILE & ACTIVATE Pipeline
Data Quality (DQ) Foreign Key Check (fk_sic_check) catching the IBM SIC 3570 vs 4-digit leaf anomaly
Generic fk_sic_check orphan detection and parent_summary_code hierarchy recovery (no company- or code-specific logic)
H-MEM (7-Service Hierarchical Memory with 8-term hybrid scoring, outcome-scored Trust Ledger, rule reinforcement, Conflict Detection & Sleep Preview)
Markovian (Bounded-context chunk reasoning: each chunk is a real analysis stage, [STATE_CHECKPOINT]/[TASK_COMPLETE] protocol, 4-step carryover cascade, measured vs spec-projected token ledgers)
World Model (Idempotent 6-stage entity/observation pipeline with deterministic SHA-256 ent_ IDs)
Scout Intent (5-layer security guard + HMAC-SHA256 signed ExecutionContracts)
Meterless Nightshift Runtime 1.4 (Provider Contract v4, /connect link parser, /v1/models discovery, rt-local rejection)
NVIDIA NIM Nemotron Routing (nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b, nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b, nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b)
Data-grounded deterministic fallback text supplied by each agent for zero-credential offline judge reproducibility (verdicts are always computed in code)
Multi-file architectural synthesis, AGENTS.md contract conformance verification, and iterative test-driven refinement
